pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

pokedexEntries.vi: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

pokedexEntries.za: Contrary to appearances, Mabosstiff has a kind heart-but it will relentlessly chase down and put an end to any foe that dares threaten its family.
